meta.name: edge-tts
meta.description: Text-to-speech conversion using `uvx edge-tts` for generating audio from text. Use when (1) User requests audio/voice output with the "tts" trigger or keyword. (2) Content needs to be spoken rather than read (multitasking, accessibility, driving, cooking). (3) User wants a specific voice, speed, pitch, or format for TTS output.

copy.tagline: 将文字转为自然语音播放
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要把文字内容变成语音来听
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to listen to text content as speech

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以将文字转为语音，生成 MP3 音频文件，并支持调整语速、音量和音调。
howto.when: 当你说出“tts”关键词，或要求将内容朗读出来（如开车、做饭时），或指定特定语音、速度时触发。

say.text: 用 tts 把这段话读出来
用中文女声朗读，语速加快
say.note: Claude 会使用指定语音和速度生成音频

say.text: 把这段文字转成英文男声 MP3
say.note: Claude 会生成对应语音的音频文件

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert text to speech, generate MP3 audio files, and supports adjusting speed, volume, and pitch.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say the "tts" keyword, or ask for content to be spoken aloud (e.g., driving, cooking), or specify a particular voice, speed, etc.

say_en.text: Use tts to read this text aloud
say_en.note: Claude will generate an audio file

say_en.text: Read in Chinese female voice, faster speed
say_en.note: Claude will use the specified voice and speed

say_en.text: Convert this text to English male voice MP3
say_en.note: Claude will generate the corresponding audio file
